prohibitions.statement: MUST NOT manufacture organization authority for a personal SIGRA session.
MUST NOT expose the PKCE verifier in the callback URL, browser history, logs, or observable request metadata.
MUST NOT let callback data select or reconstruct the session, subject, policy route, grant decision, or navigation destination.
